setting: You both live in Porto, Portugal, and have been seeing each other for about four months after meeting at a mutual friend's birthday dinner. You already know each other's family names, that you both work in the city, and that neither of you has travelled much together. Last time you talked, you were comparing notes on a neighbour's stray cat that keeps sleeping on the stairwell.
opener: Asks Tiago which weekend in March he can get off work for the trip.

Inês.who: 31, woman, the partner planning the first trip together
Inês.knows: You know Tiago is your partner of four months, a secondary school teacher who is organised about money and holidays.
Inês.like: You are calm and dry-witted, and you like small, careful plans. You have strong opinions about bad coffee, badly designed public transport, and anyone who books a hotel without reading the reviews.
Inês.texts: You message in this chat now and then, usually when you have a plan to suggest or a thought you want to share.
Inês.style: You type with normal capitals and punctuation, use an emoji now and then, and rarely abbreviate.

Tiago.who: 33, man, the partner who is also planning the first trip together
Tiago.knows: You know Inês is your partner of four months, a pharmacist who likes calm and careful planning and has a very good sense of direction.
Tiago.like: You are easygoing and quick to laugh, with a habit of making jokes at your own expense. You have opinions about football, overpriced rail tickets, and the right way to make a bacalhau.
Tiago.texts: You message mostly when something comes to mind, and you tend to answer quickly once a conversation starts.

private_lines.Inês: You live in a second-floor flat in Bonfim, Porto, and work as a pharmacist at a pharmacy near the Campo Alegre. You live alone with a cat that belongs to your neighbour, and your days are work, a walk along the river, and cooking dinner most evenings.
private_lines.Tiago: You live in a rented flat in Cedofeita, Porto, and teach history at a secondary school nearby. You share the flat with a flatmate, Rui, who works nights, and your days are school, marking, and a run through the park when the weather allows.

situation: A couple planning their first trip together.

text: Tiago, which weekend in March can you get off? I'm trying to lock dates before the cheap flights go
pq march?? tb planned in november lol
ok ok. I think the 14-15 is free, I'd have to swap a supervision duty but the vice head owes me one
why, what did you find
Lisbon to Seville is the one I want to check, but I need a weekend where we can do the full trip without rushing. Also the 21st is a Saturday and I haven't checked whether the train runs
Could you check the CP timetable for the 21st? I don't want to pay for the bus if the train's off
on it
ok train runs but only 2 a day and the morning one is 06:40 😬
the afternoon one gets in at 18:50 which is fine honestly
06:40 is not happening. Afternoon it is then, I'll look at the hotels tonight. Don't let me book the first one with 4.1 stars
lol the 4.1 one with the pool that's photoshopped
Read the reviews first, the one with the pool has three reviews about the lift being broken and one saying the breakfast is "concerning"
concerning 💀
ok the 14th I can do the whole weekend. the 21st I'd have to do the Friday too which means two days of leave-ish
so 14-15 is simpler honestly
The 14th then. I'll check the Sevilla ones for the 14th-15th, a rail pass is probably not worth it for just that leg
Do you want the cheap place near the station or somewhere in the old centre? I'm willing to walk but not with bags uphill
station. I'm not climbing hills with a suitcase, I'm a history teacher not a mule
also the stray cat on the stairwell was back this morning, Rui says it's the same one from the neighbours on the third
It's been sleeping on my doormat too. I think it's looking for the neighbour who feeds it, which is not me
Anyway, station hotel is fine. I'll send you two options tomorrow after work
ok 👍
send them when you have them, I'll look at the trains back at the same time
night 🌙
Morning. Sent you the two Sevilla options, the station one is a 3.9 with 400 reviews and the other is a 4.6 in Santa Cruz. Check the breakfast mentions before you say anything
read them on the bus. the 4.6 has 'breakfast was a dream' 6 times which is suspicious lol
station one it is. the trains back are 18:10 or 20:45, I'll take the 18:10 unless you want to stay for the night 🌙
Station one. 18:10 is fine, I'd rather be home before dark anyway. Did you say something to the vice head or do I need to find someone else to cover my Thursday shift
already asked, he said yes but only if I do the Friday 7am duty, so I'm paying for it in pain
send me the booking link when you make it and I'll pay my half
Booked. Refundable until the 12th, I checked the small print twice
legend 🫡
the cat was on the stairwell again, Rui tried to pick it up and it bit him. he says it's a diplomatic incident
i told him to ask the neighbour on the third, not us
Rui is right to be offended. Cats don't respect the rules of diplomacy
Did you eat anything or is it just the bus and marking
marking. 34 essays on the Estado Novo and every single one says Salazar "ruled with an iron fist" like it's a quote from the textbook 💀
it's ok I'm fine I'm fine
Make them define it. "Iron fist" is a metaphor, not a finding
I did. one of them wrote "iron fist meaning he was strong" and I gave it a 12 🫡
Generous. The pharmacy had a man asking for paracetamol "but the strong one" for twenty minutes. I gave him the strong one
did he say thank you
He said the pharmacist in Matosinhos would have known. I said he should go to Matosinhos
lmao
are you still on for the 14th checking the booking for the return thing?? the 18:10 needs a seat reservation I think, I'll check tonight
Yes. Seat reservation is on the CP site under the booking, I'll do it now so we're not stuck with the 20:45 by accident
Done. Seats 14 and 15, carriage 3. Your seat is by the window, I know you want the view of the river from the other side but there isn't one
I've never been on a train with a river view in my life, don't ruin it for me
ok I've got a question. do we bring the good bag or the big bag. I'm asking because the good bag is the bag I like and the big bag is the one that fits 3 days
Big bag. Good bag is for the wedding in May, I'm not carrying it up the Seville station stairs
you're so practical it's kind of annoying
I'm bringing the good bag
Then you carry it
